stageDesc.Absent: Agility isn't on the agenda yet. The opportunity is to build awareness and secure leadership sponsorship before anything else.
stageDesc.Nascent: The conversation has started. Named sponsors and early experiments exist — now it needs structure, roles, and consistent tooling.
stageDesc.Designed: The operating model is taking shape: rules of engagement, documented roles, and rolled-out training. The work now is to make it stick and scale.
stageDesc.Accelerating: Agility is delivering — peer partnerships, championed roles, and autonomous teams. Focus on shared accountability and spreading what works.
stageDesc.Flying: Agility is a way of life: leaders coach, teams reinvent continuously, and learning compounds. The work is sustaining it and mentoring the next wave.

ui.intro: For each dimension, choose the description that best matches your organization today. Be honest — the profile is only useful if it’s real.
ui.hint: Select a level for all four dimensions to continue.
ui.top: Top of the model. Sustain it, and mentor others toward it.
ui.focusTail: Maturity compounds when the weakest dimension moves — that’s the highest-leverage place to invest next.
